name: PRXVTStaking reward accounting not settled on stPRXVT transfer
summary: PRXVTStaking issued transferable stPRXVT receipts but did not settle or reset reward accounting on transfer, so each recipient's earned() counted rewards from before it held the stake. The attacker staked, then moved the receipt through a series of fresh CREATE2 addresses, each claiming the full accrued reward again.

campaign.selection: successful transactions from attacker EOA 0x7407f9bdc4140d5e284ea7de32a9de6037842f45 to its contract 0x702980b1ed754c214b79192a4d7c39106f19bce9

notes: The anchor is the first claim; 0x4f4aaf09 before it only staked. The owner's notifyRewardAmount after deployment only funded rewards, and pause() followed the campaign.

Loss is PRXVTStaking's net PRXVT outflow over the anchor and campaign (the attacker's stakes netted), 6.3% of supply. The dumping took PRXVT from about 0.0073 to 0.0015 USD, so it is valued at what the attacker realised (rule 12): 31.03 ETH paid to its EOA in the three sale transactions in refs, at DefiLlama's ETH price.
